steps.title: Keep only 2021 records
steps.change: The question asks about revenue *in 2021*. Other years cannot decide whether a customer qualifies.
steps.added_sql:
SELECT customer_id, year, revenue
FROM Customers
WHERE year = 2021
ORDER BY customer_id;
steps.sql:
SELECT customer_id, year, revenue
FROM Customers
WHERE year = 2021
ORDER BY customer_id;

steps.title: Keep only positive revenue
steps.sql:
SELECT customer_id, year, revenue
FROM Customers
WHERE year = 2021 AND revenue > 0
ORDER BY customer_id;

steps.title: Return the requested column
